description: This file provides a partial PHP implementation of the mbstring extension, offering multibyte string functionalities such as encoding conversions, string manipulation, case transformations, and encoding detection, mainly UTF-8 centric.

classes.name: Mbstring
classes.description: A class encapsulating partial multibyte string functions, primarily UTF-8 focused, implementing encoding conversions, string case transformations, and other multibyte operations.

methods.name: mb_convert_encoding
methods.description: Converts the encoding of a string or array of strings, handling base64, HTML entities, and iconv conversions.

methods.name: mb_convert_variables
methods.description: Recursively converts variables to a specified encoding.

methods.name: mb_decode_mimeheader
methods.description: Decodes a MIME header field.

methods.name: mb_encode_mimeheader
methods.description: Encodes a string for use in MIME headers (noted as buggy, suggests using iconv_mime_encode).

methods.name: mb_decode_numericentity
methods.description: Decodes HTML numeric entities to characters.

methods.name: mb_encode_numericentity
methods.description: Encodes characters into HTML numeric entities.

methods.name: mb_convert_case
methods.description: Performs case folding (lowercase, uppercase, title case) on strings, supporting UTF-8.

methods.name: mb_internal_encoding
methods.description: Sets or gets the internal character encoding.

methods.name: mb_language
methods.description: Sets or gets the current language locale.

methods.name: mb_list_encodings
methods.description: Returns an array of supported encodings.

methods.name: mb_encoding_aliases
methods.description: Returns alias array for a given encoding.

methods.name: mb_check_encoding
methods.description: Checks if string or array of strings are valid in a given encoding.

methods.name: mb_detect_encoding
methods.description: Detects the encoding of a string within a list of encodings.

methods.name: mb_detect_order
methods.description: Sets or gets the detection order of encodings.

methods.name: mb_strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string in characters.

methods.name: mb_strpos
methods.description: Finds position of first occurrence of a string within another.

methods.name: mb_strrpos
methods.description: Finds position of last occurrence of a string within another.

methods.name: mb_str_split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array of smaller strings.

methods.name: mb_strtolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase.

methods.name: mb_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase.

methods.name: mb_substitute_character
methods.description: Sets or gets the substitute character for malformed sequences.

methods.name: mb_substr
methods.description: Returns part of a string.

methods.name: mb_stripos
methods.description: Finds position of first occurrence of a case-insensitive substring.

methods.name: mb_stristr
methods.description: Finds first occurrence of a string within another, case-insensitive, returns part.

methods.name: mb_strrchr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: mb_strrichr
methods.description: Finds last occurrence of a character, case-insensitive.

methods.name: mb_strripos
methods.description: Finds position of last occurrence of a substring, case-insensitive.

methods.name: mb_strstr
methods.description: Finds first occurrence of a string, returns part.

methods.name: mb_get_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about mbstring environment.

methods.name: mb_http_input
methods.description: Detects HTTP input character encoding.

methods.name: mb_http_output
methods.description: Sets or gets HTTP output character encoding.

methods.name: mb_strwidth
methods.description: Returns the width of a string.

methods.name: mb_substr_count
methods.description: Counts occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: mb_output_handler
methods.description: Handles encoding conversions on output buffer.

methods.name: mb_chr
methods.description: Returns a character from its Unicode code point.

methods.name: mb_ord
methods.description: Returns the Unicode code point of a character.

methods.name: mb_str_pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a desired length with a specified string and padding type.

methods.name: mb_ucfirst
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to uppercase.

methods.name: mb_lcfirst
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to lowercase.

methods.name: mb_trim
methods.description: Trims characters from both ends of a string.

methods.name: mb_ltrim
methods.description: Trims characters from the beginning of a string.

methods.name: mb_rtrim
methods.description: Trims characters from the end of a string.
